name: clawseccheck-ci-tools
description: Pinned CLI tools used by CI/publish workflows, installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` against a committed lockfile so the transitive tree is reproducible and lifecycle scripts never run in a token-holding job.
//overrides: Transitive versions forced to the first patched release of each open advisory, because the pinned tools' own ranges cannot reach it.
undici: clawhub 0.23.3 (latest) pins 7.29.0 exactly; this runs in the token-holding publish job.
katex: micromark-extension-math 3.1.0 (latest, via markdownlint) requires ^0.16; markdownlint only uses its syntax extension, katex is imported by the unused HTML renderer.
markdown-it, js-yaml, smol-toml: markdownlint-cli 0.49.1 tilde ranges stop below the fix.
Drop an entry once the tool that pulls it in ships a range that includes the fix.
